chunks: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم looked at the children of ʿAlī and Jaʿfar عليهما السلام and said: “Our daughters are for our sons, and our sons are for our daughters.”

key_terms.أَوْلَادِ: children or offspring being referred to
key_terms.النَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, the one speaking in this report
key_terms.بَنَاتُنَا: our daughters, referring to female descendants
key_terms.بَنِينَا: our sons, referring to male descendants

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about marriage between the children of ʿAlī and Jaʿfar عليهما السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith records a statement of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم regarding the children of ʿAlī and Jaʿfar عليهما السلام. It reflects familial compatibility and closeness within the Prophet’s kinship line in the context of marriage.
